title: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon
subtitle: A young witch enters the forest
summary: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon is PlatinumGames' action adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 17 March 2023.
body: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon is PlatinumGames' action adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 17 March 2023. It follows Bayonetta's younger self, Cereza, as she enters Avalon Forest in search of the power to save her mother. A summoned demon becomes trapped inside her stuffed cat, Cheshire. The journey begins with two reluctant companions whose different abilities must work together, presented through illustrated pages and narration that give this earlier chapter the form of a storybook.

The player controls Cereza and Cheshire together, assigning movement and actions to separate sides of the controller. Cereza can bind enemies with magic, leaving Cheshire to attack them. Away from combat, their cooperation opens routes through the forest. Cheshire can grow into his demon form or shrink into the toy Cereza carries. Switching between those forms changes how the pair cross an obstacle and stay close enough to help each other when the path becomes dangerous.

Elemental powers expand Cheshire's abilities and make previously blocked routes accessible. Returning through the forest can therefore reveal something that the companions could see earlier but could not reach. Combat and exploration both develop the same relationship: Cereza needs the demon's strength, while Cheshire depends on her to restore his magic. The painted environments keep the characters small within an uncertain world, allowing the gradual confidence of the young witch to emerge through the actions the player learns to perform with both companions.
